page.content:
1997 game that made Jin the new lead against Ogre.

How Tekken 3 connects

  • Character: Jin Kazama — Tekken 3 made Jin Kazama the new lead against Ogre.
  • Topic: Tekken — Tekken 3 is the game that passed the lead to Jin.
  • Character: Ling Xiaoyu — Tekken 3 introduced Ling Xiaoyu to the Iron Fist cast.
  • Character: Eddy Gordo — Tekken 3 introduced Eddy Gordo's capoeira.

What is Tekken 3?

Tekken 3 introduced Jin Kazama, Ling Xiaoyu, Hwoarang, Eddy, and a world-spanning hunt for Ogre, shifting the saga from father-and-son to a third generation.

Key threads lead to Jin Kazama, Tekken, Ling Xiaoyu and Eddy Gordo.
